sources.title: Jensen Huang quits Nvidia as scandal rocks AI giant
sources.excerpt: Jensen Huang, the leather-jacketed architect of the artificial intelligence boom, resigned as chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday after revelations of two extramarital affairs, including one with a woman accused of spying for China.

sources.text: Jensen Huang spying scandal. In October 2026, The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang, the chief executive of Nvidia, had been the target of an espionage plot involving the government of China. Huang was involved in an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, a 52-year-old Chinese executive of a Singaporean company, who had allegedly been recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to serve as a spy.
